evals.name: past-paper-solutions
evals.prompt: here is question 1 of my EEE329 term final, session 2021-22 (eee329-2021-q1.txt). make me the full solution pdf in my past paper format, like my 2020-21 solutions
evals.expected_output: A past-paper Markdown (type past-paper) with the paper block copied exactly with marks, one solution block per part with Answer sections, a Final Concise Answer, correct numbers, and a clean PDF.
assertions: front matter sets type: past-paper
linter reports no errors
PDF builds with a clean log
paper block keeps both parts with Marks 4 and Marks 5
question text copied exactly (key phrase of 1(b) present)
one solution heading per part: 1(a) and 1(b)
a Final Concise Answer section exists
1(a) results correct: m = 0.6, 9.995 and 10.005 MHz, 3 V
1(b) result correct: 540 kHz

evals.name: formula-sheet
evals.prompt: Can you make a formula sheet PDF in my format from my FM notes (fm-theory.md)? Every formula, with what each symbol means.
evals.expected_output: A formula-sheet Markdown (type formula-sheet) with Title | Equation | Notation | Reference tables holding every formula of the notes unchanged, and a clean PDF.
assertions: front matter sets type: formula-sheet
linter reports no errors
PDF builds with a clean log
uses the Title | Equation | Notation | Reference table
every display formula of the notes appears on the sheet
every table row has a non-empty Notation cell

evals.name: question-bank
evals.prompt: write 3 practice numericals on FM peak deviation and Carson's rule with full solutions, based on my notes fm-theory.md, as a question bank pdf in my style
evals.expected_output: A question-bank Markdown (type question-bank) with N1-N3 and their linked solutions, results in bold with units, and a clean PDF.
assertions: front matter sets type: question-bank
linter reports no errors
PDF builds with a clean log
three numericals N1, N2, N3, each with its #### Solution
every solution states a bold result
solutions use Carson's rule as written in the notes (2(Δf + B))

evals.name: convert-finished-notes
evals.prompt: fm-theory.md is a finished part of my COM notes. Turn it into a PDF in my LaTeX style, don't change my content.
evals.expected_output: The notes converted unchanged (only front matter or a title added), every equation preserved, and a clean PDF.
assertions: PDF builds with a clean log
linter reports no errors
every equation of the notes is in the Markdown unchanged
no sentence of the notes was removed or reworded
every display equation reaches the LaTeX body
headings start at the first numbered level (no 0.x numbering)

evals.name: project-report-day
evals.prompt: Turn my day 3 log (day-03-log.txt) into the Day 3 chapter of my RTL-to-GDSII lab report and build the pdf.
evals.expected_output: A project-report Markdown (type project-report) with a Day 03 chapter, Command/Output Snippet blocks taken from the log, the log's real numbers only, the repo as a repocard, and a clean PDF.
assertions: front matter sets type: project-report
linter reports no errors
PDF builds with a clean log
a '# Day 03' (or Day 3) chapter heading
Command and Output Snippet labels used for the flow commands
the log's results are reported: 13850 cells, overflow 0.0995, core area 551.17 x 562.85
no invented numbers: every number of 3+ digits in the Markdown appears in the log
the OpenLane repo is given as a repocard
every label carries the day prefix (d03 or d3)
Day 3 is numbered Chapter 3
